adversaries.name: Fen Lurker
adversaries.description: A long-limbed thing that waits under the water for something to wade past.
adversaries.motivesAndTactics: Take the straggler, drown what it takes, and be gone before the others turn round.

adversaries.name: Bandit Cutter
adversaries.description: A road robber in boiled leather, more confident than skilled.
adversaries.motivesAndTactics: Surround whoever looks richest; run the moment it stops being easy.

adversaries.name: Bandit Archer
adversaries.description: Perched where the road narrows, with a quiver and no hurry.
adversaries.motivesAndTactics: Stay out of reach, shoot whoever is helping others, move when found.

adversaries.name: Rot Hound
adversaries.description: Dogs that did not stop when they should have. They run as one and smell worse.
adversaries.motivesAndTactics: Pull down the isolated one; ignore pain entirely.

adversaries.name: Grave Moth
adversaries.description: Pale, hand-sized, and drawn to anything still warm.
adversaries.motivesAndTactics: Smother lights, then faces. Never alone.

adversaries.name: Wandering Hedge Priest
adversaries.description: Robed, footsore, and carrying more authority than the robe deserves.
adversaries.motivesAndTactics: Talk first, bless allies second, and leave before the fighting is settled.

adversaries.name: Stone Golem
adversaries.description: A slab of quarried rock given orders once and never told to stop.
adversaries.motivesAndTactics: Break whatever is nearest and in the way. It does not choose targets.

adversaries.name: Briar Wraith
adversaries.description: A tangle of dead bramble that moves when nobody is looking straight at it.
adversaries.motivesAndTactics: Separate one from the group, wound and withdraw, wear them down.

adversaries.name: Bandit Captain
adversaries.description: The one whose orders the others actually follow, in a stolen officer’s coat.
adversaries.motivesAndTactics: Hold the line, send others first, and bargain when losing.

adversaries.name: Hollow Knight
adversaries.description: Armour standing upright with nothing inside it but intent.
adversaries.motivesAndTactics: Fight to the end without bad or hurry. It has waited longer than this.

items.name: Suspended Rod
items.description: This flat rod is inscribed with runes. When you activate the rod, it is immediately suspended in place. Until the rod is deactivated, it can't move, doesn't abide by the rules of gravity, and remains in place.

items.name: Glamour Stone
items.description: Activate this pebble-sized stone to memorize the appearance of someone you can see. Spend a Hope to magically recreate this guise on yourself as an illusion.

items.name: Empty Chest
items.description: This magical chest appears empty. When you speak a specific trigger word or action and open the chest, you can see the items stored within it.

items.name: Companion Case
items.description: This case can fit a small animal companion. While the companion is inside, the animal and case are immune to all damage and harmful effects.

items.name: Piercing Arrows
items.description: Three times per rest when you succeed on an attack with one of these arrows, you can add your Proficiency to the damage roll.

items.name: Valorstone
items.description:

Resilient: Before you mark your last Armor Slot, roll a d6. On a result of 6, reduce the severity by one threshold without marking an Armor Slot.

items.name: Skeleton Key
items.description: When you use this key to open a locked door, you gain advantage on the Finesse Roll.

items.name: Arcane Prism
items.description: Position this prism in a location of your choosing and activate it. All allies within Close range of it gain a +1 bonus to their Spellcast Rolls. While activated, the prism can't be moved. Once the prism is deactivated, it can't be activated again until your next long rest.

items.name: Minor Stamina Potion Recipe

items.name: Minor Health Potion Recipe

items.name: Homing Compasses
items.description: These two compasses point toward each other no matter how far apart they are.

items.name: Corrector Sprite

items.name: Gecko Gloves
items.description: You can climb up vertical surfaces and across ceilings.

items.name: Lorekeeper
items.description: You can store the name and details of up to three hostile creatures inside this book. You gain a +1 bonus to action rolls against those creatures.

items.name: Vial of Darksmoke Recipe

You can attach this stone to a weapon that doesn't already have a feature. The weapon gains the following feature.
Brutal: When you roll the maximum value on a damage die, roll an additional damage die.

You can attach this stone to a weapon that doesn't already have a feature. The weapon gains the following feature.
Powerful: On a successful attack, roll an additional damage die and discard the lowest result.

items.name: Glider

items.name: Ring of Silence
items.description: Spend a Hope to activate this ring. Your footsteps are silent until your next rest.

items.name: Calming Pendant
items.description: When you would mark your last Stress, roll a d6. On a result of 5 or higher, don't mark it.

items.name: Dual Flask
items.description: This flask can hold two different liquids. You can swap between them by flipping a small switch on the flask's side.

items.name: Bag of Ficklesand
items.description: You can convince this small bag of sand to be much heavier or lighter with a successful Presence Roll (10). Additionally, on a successful Finesse Roll (10), you can blow a bit of sand into a target's face to make them temporarily Vulnerable.

items.name: Ring of Resistance
items.description: Once per long rest, you can activate this ring after a successful attack against you to halve the damage.

items.name: Phoenix Feather
items.description: If you have at least one Phoenix Feather on you when you fall unconscious, you gain a +1 bonus to the roll you make to determine whether you gain a scar.

items.name: Box of Many Goods

items.name: Airblade Charm

items.name: Portal Seed
items.description: You can plant this seed in the ground to grow a portal in that spot. The portal is ready to use in 24 hours. You can use this portal to travel to any other location where you planted a portal seed. A portal can be destroyed by dealing any amount of magic damage to it.

items.name: Paragon's Chain
items.description: As a downtime move, you can meditate on an ideal or principle you hold dear and focus your will into this chain. Once per long rest, you can spend a Hope to roll a d20 as your Hope Die for rolls that directly align with that principle.

items.name: Elusive Amulet

items.name: Hopekeeper Locket

items.name: Lakestrider Boots

items.description: This honey can be used to glue two objects together permanently.

items.description: You can plant this seed in soil. It instantly grows into a small flower that records everything it hears for up to one week. When plucked, the flower recites what it recorded in real time, then withers.

items.name: Displacement Token
items.description: You can swallow this token to conjure two illusions of yourself that you can control. Each illusion lasts until it takes damage or until your next rest.

items.name: Night Hag's Dust
items.description: You can blow this dust in an adversary's face to prevent them from clearing Stress until your next long rest.

items.name: Self-Sewing Thread
items.description: You can use this thread to clear either a Hit Point or 2 Armor Slots.

items.name: Stonemason's Fortune
items.description: When you throw this gray brick on the ground, it immediately grows into a 6-foot-tall, 10-foot-wide, and 2-foot-deep wall of solid stone.

items.name: Mnemonic Potion
items.description: You can drink this potion to Utilize an Experience without spending a Hope.

items.name: Salamander Salve
items.description: You can apply this salve to your skin to make yourself immune to heat until your next rest.

items.name: Green Ooze Oil
items.description: You can coat your weapon in this oil. The next successful attack you make with this weapon deals an extra 1d8 magic damage and temporarily Corrodes the target. While Corroded, the target gains a −2 penalty to their damage thresholds.

items.name: Sunlight Orb
items.description: You can shatter this orb to make the area within Very Far range appear as though it's sunlit daytime for the next 24 hours.

items.name: Moonlight Orb
items.description: You can shatter this orb to make the area within Very Far range appear as though it's moonlit nighttime for the next 24 hours.

items.name: Midas Flask
items.description: You can pour this small flask of alchemical liquid over a mundane item to instantly transmute it into a handful of gold.

items.name: Staff of Reversal
items.description: You can break this staff against the ground to reverse one magical transformation or effect within Far range.

items.name: Berserker's Brew
items.description: When you drink this dram of liquid, you gain a bonus to your Strength and a penalty to your Finesse and Knowledge equal to your Instinct (minimum 1). This effect lasts until you make a death move or until your next rest.

items.name: Emberite Shard
items.description: Choose a point within Far range. All targets within Close range of that point must succeed on a Reaction Roll (16) or take 3d6 magic damage and become temporarily Ablaze. While Ablaze, a creature must roll a d4 whenever they make an action roll. On a result of 1, they mark a Hit Point. On a result of 4, they clear the Ablaze condition.

items.name: Arcticite Shard
items.description: Choose a point within Far range. All targets within Close range of that point must succeed on a Reaction Roll (16) or take 3d6 magic damage and become temporarily Restrained by ice.

items.name: Fulgurite Shard
items.description: Choose a point within Far range. All targets within Close range of that point must succeed on a Reaction Roll (16) or take 3d6 magic damage and mark 1d4 Stress as lightning crackles through the area.

items.name: Demiurge's Draught
items.description: You can drink this draught to gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency for your next successful attack roll.

items.name: Cockerel Claw Tea
items.description: You can drink this tea to refresh your features as if you had taken a long rest.

items.name: Potion of Vigilance
items.description: You can drink this potion to gain a +1 bonus to your Evasion until you mark a Hit Point.

items.name: Cacophonous Concoction
items.description: When you drink this potion, anything you say or do in the next hour becomes impossible for a witness to recount. Any attempts they make to communicate what they saw, heard, or otherwise sensed comes out garbled or nonsensical.

items.name: Nightmare Mead
items.description: You can drink this potion to discover the deepest fear of the next person you make eye contact with. When you do, the GM gains a Fear.

items.name: Stake of Abjuration
items.description: You can hammer this stake into the ground and make a proclamation. Until your next rest, a creature within Far range of the stake who transgresses that proclamation must mark a Stress. The stake lasts until your next rest, then it shatters.

items.name: Psychopomp's Shroud
items.description: You can place this shroud over the corpse of a recently deceased creature. The creature's spirit enters the shroud and becomes your spectral assistant until the next sunrise, when they pass through the veil of death and take the shroud with them.

items.name: Phial of Deep Ink
items.description: You can drink this bottle of ink to transform into a cephalopod of roughly your size for the next hour. You gain rubbery skin, soft bones, the ability to breathe underwater, and new limbs until you have eight total.

items.name: Mesmer's Tonic
items.description: When you drink this tonic, the only thing you can hear until your next rest are the surface thoughts of creatures within Very Close range.

items.name: Invisibility Potion
items.description: You are Hidden until you deal damage to another creature or until your next rest.

items.name: Formoid Serum
items.description: You can drink this potion to become a swarm of 16 million ants until the end of the scene. You keep and have access to all equipment, loot, and features.

items.name: Steelskin Salve
items.description: You can apply this salve to your skin to gain a bonus to your damage thresholds equal to your tier until the end of the scene.

items.name: Godling's Pomelo
items.description: You can eat this citrus fruit to clear all Hit Points and Stress.

items.name: Snakeskin Spirit
items.description: You can drink this potion to slough off your outer layer of skin and heal a scar.

items.name: Magic-User's Malison
items.description: When you release this spellcaster's trapped soul, you can cast one spell from a card in your vault as if it were in your loadout. This doesn't work for permanently vaulted cards.

items.name: Quintessential Severant
items.description: You can use this magic blade to cut one magical or metaphysical bond, such as an enchantment, contract, magical tether, or divine oath. When you do, the blade shatters.

items.name: Mask of the Echoed Self
items.description: You can wear this mask during your next level up to swap the values of any of your traits. When you do, the mask becomes your permanent face.

items.name: Necroprancer's Bell
items.description: You can break this rusted, clapperless bell against the ground to summon a skeletal steed that climbs out of the earth and serves you until the next sunrise.

items.name: Drakemantle
items.description: You can use this enchanted ancient dragon hide to gain draconic characteristics until the end of the scene, when the hide falls away in tatters. Until then, you can fly and gain a +5 bonus to your damage thresholds and a +1 bonus to your Proficiency.

items.name: Gambler's Fallacy
items.description: You can spend any number of handfuls of gold by placing them into this slotted ceramic jar shaped like a pig. When you throw the jar at a point within Far range, it explodes and deals 1d20 magic damage for each handful of gold spent to all creatures within Close range of that point. All gold within the jar is destroyed.

items.name: Lionheart Tonic
items.description: You can drink this tonic to gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency until you roll with Fear.

items.name: Tears of the Undying Hero
items.description: When you drink this potion, death can't touch you until your next long rest. When you would mark your last Hit Point, instead of making a death move, you make one final action roll before falling into a dreamless slumber until an ally chooses the Tend to Wounds downtime move to clear your Hit Points.

items.name: Featherstep Potion
items.description: You can drink this potion to sprout small wings from your ankles that give you a bonus to your Evasion equal to your tier until your next rest.

scenes.name: The Hollow Vault
scenes.intro: Pines close over the trail, and the stream runs black between them. East, past the marsh, the vault mouth stands open in the hillside - and the cold coming out of it has never seen the sun.

function.name: Vault Door
function.flavor: An iron-banded vault door seals the eastern chamber. Its lock is ancient — but the tumblers may still turn.

onSuccessWithGood.text: The mechanism yields silently. The way is open.

onSuccessWithBad.text: The door grinds open — far too loudly. Something stirs beyond.

onFailureWithGood.text: The door refuses to budge, but you sense the trick of it now.

onFailureWithBad.text: Your effort echoes like a war drum. The door stays shut.

function.name: Old Wooden Chest
function.flavor: An old wooden chest sits rotting in the corner, its lock crusted with rust.

onSuccessWithGood.text: The lock clicks open smoothly. Inside, treasure glints in the dim light.

onSuccessWithBad.text: The lid creaks open — but the rusted hinge SHRIEKS, echoing down the corridors...

onFailureWithGood.text: The lock holds, but you withdraw your pick before it snaps. You can try again.

onFailureWithBad.text: A needle springs from the lock mechanism and bites your hand. Poison burns.

function.name: Crumbling Pillar
function.flavor: Just past the door, a crumbling pillar leans over the vault floor. One good shove could bring it down.

scenes.name: The Sounding Pit
scenes.intro: The stair gives out into a round chamber. Water moves somewhere below, and the walls carry every sound twice.

function.name: The stair up
function.flavor: The steps you came down. They go back.

function.name: A banded strongbox
function.flavor: Someone left in a hurry, and left this behind.

effects.text: The word you were given does the work for you.

function.lockedText: The lid will not shift. Whatever holds it is not a lock.

lines.text: The carving in the pillar opens its eyes.

lines.speaker: The Warden
lines.text: Three hundred years, and the first thing through that door is a thief with a lantern.

choices.text: We are not thieves. We came for the vault.
Warden. I know what you are.

effects.text: The eyes close again.

lines.speaker: The Warden
lines.text: I was left here to keep count. I have counted very carefully.

lines.speaker: The Warden
lines.text: The door does not open for the living. It never did. But it might open for the polite.

choices.text: Then let us ask it politely.

onSuccessWithBad.text: It yields — and something deeper in the vault notices.

onFailureWithGood.text: The Warden is unmoved, but not unkind.

onFailureWithBad.text: The eyes narrow. You have been counted.

choices.text: We will find our own way in.

lines.speaker: The Warden
lines.text: Then you know what I am owed. Ask, and ask well.

lines.speaker: The Warden
lines.text: Go on, then. Mind the third step; it remembers.

lines.speaker: The Warden
lines.text: Then we are done talking.

lines.speaker: Tobin
lines.text: Travellers! Sit by the fire a while. I have things to sell, if you have coin to spend.

lines.speaker: Tobin
lines.text: Take your time. Everything is honest. Mostly. And I buy, too - four in ten of what a thing is worth, which is generous, this far from a town.

lines.speaker: Tobin
lines.text: The vault. Folk go in with full purses and come out lighter, or not at all. Either way, somebody needs a draught.

lines.speaker: Tobin
lines.text: Mind the husks.

lines.speaker: Wren
lines.text: Travellers! Sit, sit. You have the look of people about to do something foolish in that vault.

lines.speaker: Wren
lines.text: Anything else, while the fire lasts?

lines.speaker: Wren
lines.text: Wren. I sing for my supper, and Tobin there sells it back to me at a mark-up.

lines.speaker: Wren
lines.text: My songbook. Forty years of verses. I left it in a crate in the vault when the husks came up the stairs. Bring it back and I will pay you for it.

lines.speaker: Wren
lines.text: The crate by the east wall, past the door. Mind the husks, and mind the pages.

lines.speaker: Wren
lines.text: Every page! Here - fifteen gold, and Tobin will have it off you soon enough.

lines.speaker: Wren
lines.text: Tobin pays four in ten of what a thing is worth, and calls it generous. Sell him what you must, and buy the draughts.

lines.speaker: Wren
lines.text: Safe roads, and bring me a story.

items.name: Gold
items.description: Coins, mostly. Some of them are even coins from here.

items.name: The Warden's word
items.description: Not written down anywhere. The door knows it when it hears it.

items.name: Brass key
items.description: Small, and green with age.

items.name: Husk carapace
items.description: Light, and still faintly warm.

items.name: Wren's songbook
items.description: Forty years of verses, most of them rude.

quests.name: The Warden's Word
quests.summary: Something in the pillar has kept this vault for three hundred years. It knows a word that opens what is below.

objectives.text: Get the word out of the Warden.
objectives.summary: The Warden gave up its word. Whatever it opens is below, in the pit.

objectives.text: Open the strongbox in the pit.

quests.name: The Lost Verse
quests.summary: Wren the Wandering Bard left her songbook in a crate in the vault when the husks came up the stairs.

objectives.text: Find Wren's songbook in the vault.
objectives.summary: It was in the crate by the east wall, a little chewed.

objectives.text: Bring it back to Wren at the camp.
objectives.summary: Every page. She paid in gold, and in a verse nobody asked for.

cards.name: Hold Fast
cards.text: Spend 3 Light to clear 2 Armor Slots.

cards.name: Grapeshot
cards.text: Spend a shot: everything within Very Close takes 1d6 and is knocked back to Close range.

cards.name: Powder and Shot
cards.text: Load: put two shots on Grapeshot. It holds no more than four.

cards.name: Footnote
cards.text: When a roll goes against you, mark a Stress to put both dice back in the cup.

cards.name: Mark the Page
cards.text: Keep the place you are standing. Use it again to be back there, wherever you have got to.

cards.name: Another Round
cards.text: A round for the house: every ally within Close range clears a Stress, and the GM gains a Shadow for it.

cards.name: Barrel Through
cards.text: Shoulder through: adversaries within Melee range take 1d8 and are shoved out to Very Close.

cards.name: Rally the Line
cards.text: Spend a Light: every ally within Close range shakes something off — a Hit Point if they are badly hurt, a Stress if they are not.

adversaries.name: Merchant
adversaries.description: A pedlar with a cart, a fire and a price for everything.
adversaries.motivesAndTactics: Sell, haggle, and keep well out of anybody else’s fight.

adversaries.name: Bard
adversaries.description: A travelling singer with a lute, a sharp tongue and a better memory.
adversaries.motivesAndTactics: Talk, sing, and be somewhere else when the singing stops.

abilities.name: Power Slash
abilities.text: Put your weight behind the swing: deal 2 additional damage.

abilities.name: Iron Stance
abilities.text: While you hold your ground, your Armor Score is higher.

abilities.name: Unbroken
abilities.text: The first Severe blow you take each fight lands as Major instead.

abilities.name: Quick Hands
abilities.text: Your hands are faster than the eye: gain a bonus to action rolls made to palm or plant something.

abilities.name: Backstab
abilities.text: Against a target unaware of you, your damage roll is higher.

abilities.name: Vanish
abilities.text: Break line of sight and you are gone until you act again.

abilities.name: Arcane Ward
abilities.text: A shell of warm air holds: raise your Armor Score until your next rest.

abilities.name: Emberbolt
abilities.text: A thrown coal of fire. Your spells deal more damage.

abilities.name: Healing Word
abilities.text: Speak an ally steady: they clear a Stress.

abilities.name: Warding Flame
abilities.text: A ring of low fire. Foes crossing it are struck as they come.

effects.text: Low fire takes in a ring around their feet.

abilities.name: Cinder Burst
abilities.text: Fire blooms: every foe within Very Close of a point takes damage.

effects.text: They choose a spot across the room, and it blooms.

check.prompt: Cinder Burst: one roll, against everything the bloom covers.

abilities.name: Rallying Cry
abilities.text: Call out: each ally who can hear you clears a Stress.

effects.text: The call carries, and shoulders come up.

abilities.name: Smoke Step
abilities.text: Step from one shadow within Close range to another.

effects.text: They are there, and then they are somewhere else.

abilities.name: Shield Wall
abilities.text: Until your next turn, allies within Melee range gain a bonus to Evasion.

effects.text: A shield comes across, and there is somewhere to stand.

abilities.name: Drilled
abilities.text: Long practice in armour: your Armor Score is 1 higher.

abilities.name: Set Feet
abilities.text: You take a blow square rather than glancing: your damage thresholds are 1 higher.

abilities.name: Softstep
abilities.text: You are never quite where the eye expects: your Evasion is 1 higher.

abilities.name: Hold the Line
abilities.text: When an ally within Melee range is attacked, you may take the blow in their place.

effects.text: They set their feet, and the ground around them stops being neutral.

abilities.name: Emberflow
abilities.text: The heat answers quickly: your spellcast rolls are 1 higher.

abilities.text: Spend 3 Light to clear 2 Armor Slots.

conditionDefs.name: Warding Flame
conditionDefs.text: Low fire on the ground: anything that comes through it is struck as it comes.

effects.text: The flame takes them as they come through it.

conditionDefs.name: Behind the Shield
conditionDefs.text: Somebody is holding a shield between you and the room: +1 to your Evasion.

conditionDefs.name: Holding the Line
conditionDefs.text: A stance taken and kept: anything that comes within Very Close is dragged into reach and held there.

conditionDefs.name: Caught
conditionDefs.text: Dragged into reach of the one holding this ground.

effects.text: They come one step too close and are hauled the rest of the way in.

conditionDefs.name: Vulnerable
conditionDefs.text: All rolls targeting you have advantage.

conditionDefs.name: Hidden
conditionDefs.text: Any rolls against you have disadvantage.

conditionDefs.name: Restrained
conditionDefs.text: You can't move until this condition is cleared, but you can still take actions from your current position.

conditionDefs.name: Prone
conditionDefs.text: All rolls targeting you have advantage. It ends when you next move: you get up.

abilities.text: Long practice in armour: your Armor Score is 1 higher.

abilities.name: Set Feet
abilities.text: You take a blow square rather than glancing: your damage thresholds are 1 higher.

abilities.name: Softstep
abilities.text: You are never quite where the eye expects: your Evasion is 1 higher.

abilities.name: Hold the Line
abilities.text: When an ally within Melee range is attacked, you may take the blow in their place.

effects.text: They set their feet, and the ground around them stops being neutral.

abilities.name: Emberflow
abilities.text: The heat answers quickly: your spellcast rolls are 1 higher.

abilities.name: Hold Fast
abilities.text: Spend 3 Light to clear 2 Armor Slots.

abilities.name: Grapeshot
abilities.text: Spend a shot: everything within Very Close takes 1d6 and is knocked back to Close range.

abilities.name: Powder and Shot
abilities.text: Load: put two shots on Grapeshot. It holds no more than four.

abilities.name: Footnote
abilities.text: When a roll goes against you, mark a Stress to put both dice back in the cup.

effects.text: A note in the margin: the dice go back in the cup.

abilities.name: Mark the Page
abilities.text: Keep the place you are standing. Use it again to be back there, wherever you have got to.

abilities.name: Another Round
abilities.text: A round for the house: every ally within Close range clears a Stress, and the GM gains a Shadow for it.

abilities.name: Barrel Through
abilities.text: Shoulder through: adversaries within Melee range take 1d8 and are shoved out to Very Close.

abilities.name: Rally the Line
abilities.text: Spend a Light: every ally within Close range shakes something off — a Hit Point if they are badly hurt, a Stress if they are not.

effects.text: Rested.
Long rested.
Once a scene.

abilities.name: roar
abilities.text: It roars, and the room shakes.

code.name: Mark the Page
code.notes: The first use keeps the place; the second goes back to it and lets it go.

code.name: Rally the Line
code.notes: Each ally in Close range clears a Hit Point when badly hurt, a Stress otherwise.

conditionDefs.name: Warding Flame
conditionDefs.text: Low fire on the ground: anything that comes through it is struck as it comes.

effects.text: The flame takes them as they come through it.

conditionDefs.name: Behind the Shield
conditionDefs.text: Somebody is holding a shield between you and the room: +1 to your Evasion.

conditionDefs.name: Holding the Line
conditionDefs.text: A stance taken and kept: anything that comes within Very Close is dragged into reach and held there.

conditionDefs.name: Caught
conditionDefs.text: Dragged into reach of the one holding this ground.

effects.text: They come one step too close and are hauled the rest of the way in.

conditionDefs.name: Vulnerable
conditionDefs.text: All rolls targeting you have advantage.

conditionDefs.name: Hidden
conditionDefs.text: Any rolls against you have disadvantage.

conditionDefs.name: Restrained
conditionDefs.text: You can't move until this condition is cleared, but you can still take actions from your current position.

conditionDefs.name: Prone
conditionDefs.text: All rolls targeting you have advantage. It ends when you next move: you get up.

log.text: The stair gives out into a round chamber. Water moves somewhere below, and the walls carry every sound twice.

loadout.name: Quick Hands
loadout.text: Your hands are faster than the eye: gain a bonus to action rolls made to palm or plant something.

loadout.name: Backstab
loadout.text: Against a target unaware of you, your damage roll is higher.

granted.name: Light Fingers
granted.text: You have advantage on rolls to take something unnoticed.

granted.name: Slip the Knot
granted.text: Once per rest, free yourself from a grapple, binding or snare without rolling.

granted.name: Douse
granted.text: Put out an unattended light within Close range as a free action.

granted.name: Softstep
granted.text: You are never quite where the eye expects: your Evasion is 1 higher.

granted.name: Green Step
granted.text: Undergrowth costs you nothing to move through.

granted.name: Someone Owes You
granted.text: In a settlement, you can usually find a contact.

loadout.name: Power Slash
loadout.text: Put your weight behind the swing: deal 2 additional damage.

loadout.name: Iron Stance
loadout.text: While you hold your ground, your Armor Score is higher.

granted.name: Shield Trained
granted.text: You may use a shield without it counting against your burden.

granted.name: Drilled
granted.text: Long practice in armour: your Armor Score is 1 higher.

granted.name: Hold the Line
granted.text: When an ally within Melee range is attacked, you may take the blow in their place.

granted.name: Hold Fast
granted.text: Spend 3 Light to clear 2 Armor Slots.

granted.name: Bulwark Stance
granted.text: Allies directly behind you count as having cover.

granted.name: Set Feet
granted.text: You take a blow square rather than glancing: your damage thresholds are 1 higher.

granted.name: Deep Footing
granted.text: You are never knocked prone by a blow alone.

granted.name: Road Sense
granted.text: You know roughly where the nearest road runs.

granted.name: Rally the Line
granted.text: Spend a Light: every ally within Close range shakes something off — a Hit Point if they are badly hurt, a Stress if they are not.

loadout.name: Footnote

loadout.name: Mark the Page

loadout.name: Another Round
loadout.text: A round for the house: every ally within Close range clears a Stress, and the GM gains a Shadow for it.

vault.name: Barrel Through
vault.text: Shoulder through: adversaries within Melee range take 1d8 and are shoved out to Very Close.

granted.name: Shield Trained
granted.text: You may use a shield without it counting against your burden.

granted.name: Drilled
granted.text: Long practice in armour: your Armor Score is 1 higher.

granted.name: Hold the Line
granted.text: When an ally within Melee range is attacked, you may take the blow in their place.

granted.name: Hold Fast
granted.text: Spend 3 Light to clear 2 Armor Slots.

granted.name: Bulwark Stance
granted.text: Allies directly behind you count as having cover.

granted.name: Set Feet
granted.text: You take a blow square rather than glancing: your damage thresholds are 1 higher.

granted.name: Deep Footing
granted.text: You are never knocked prone by a blow alone.

granted.name: Road Sense
granted.text: You know roughly where the nearest road runs.

granted.name: Rally the Line
granted.text: Spend a Light: every ally within Close range shakes something off — a Hit Point if they are badly hurt, a Stress if they are not.

loadout.name: Grapeshot
loadout.text: Spend a shot: everything within Very Close takes 1d6 and is knocked back to Close range.

loadout.name: Powder and Shot
loadout.text: Load: put two shots on Grapeshot. It holds no more than four.

loadout.name: Footnote
loadout.text: When a roll goes against you, mark a Stress to put both dice back in the cup.

loadout.name: Mark the Page
loadout.text: Keep the place you are standing. Use it again to be back there, wherever you have got to.

loadout.name: Another Round
loadout.text: A round for the house: every ally within Close range clears a Stress, and the GM gains a Shadow for it.

vault.name: Barrel Through
vault.text: Shoulder through: adversaries within Melee range take 1d8 and are shoved out to Very Close.

granted.name: Shield Trained
granted.text: You may use a shield without it counting against your burden.

granted.name: Drilled
granted.text: Long practice in armour: your Armor Score is 1 higher.

granted.name: Hold the Line
granted.text: When an ally within Melee range is attacked, you may take the blow in their place.

granted.name: Hold Fast
granted.text: Spend 3 Light to clear 2 Armor Slots.

granted.name: Bulwark Stance
granted.text: Allies directly behind you count as having cover.

granted.name: Set Feet
granted.text: You take a blow square rather than glancing: your damage thresholds are 1 higher.

granted.name: Deep Footing
granted.text: You are never knocked prone by a blow alone.

loadout.name: Grapeshot
loadout.text: Spend a shot: everything within Very Close takes 1d6 and is knocked back to Close range.

loadout.name: Powder and Shot
loadout.text: Load: put two shots on Grapeshot. It holds no more than four.

loadout.name: Footnote
loadout.text: When a roll goes against you, mark a Stress to put both dice back in the cup.

loadout.name: Mark the Page
loadout.text: Keep the place you are standing. Use it again to be back there, wherever you have got to.

loadout.name: Another Round
loadout.text: A round for the house: every ally within Close range clears a Stress, and the GM gains a Shadow for it.

vault.name: Barrel Through
vault.text: Shoulder through: adversaries within Melee range take 1d8 and are shoved out to Very Close.

granted.name: Shield Trained
granted.text: You may use a shield without it counting against your burden.

granted.name: Drilled
granted.text: Long practice in armour: your Armor Score is 1 higher.

granted.name: Hold the Line
granted.text: When an ally within Melee range is attacked, you may take the blow in their place.

granted.name: Hold Fast
granted.text: Spend 3 Light to clear 2 Armor Slots.

granted.name: Bulwark Stance
granted.text: Allies directly behind you count as having cover.

granted.name: Set Feet
granted.text: You take a blow square rather than glancing: your damage thresholds are 1 higher.

granted.name: Deep Footing
granted.text: You are never knocked prone by a blow alone.

granted.name: Road Sense
granted.text: You know roughly where the nearest road runs.

granted.name: Rally the Line
granted.text: Spend a Light: every ally within Close range shakes something off — a Hit Point if they are badly hurt, a Stress if they are not.

loadout.name: Grapeshot
loadout.text: Spend a shot: everything within Very Close takes 1d6 and is knocked back to Close range.

loadout.name: Powder and Shot
loadout.text: Load: put two shots on Grapeshot. It holds no more than four.

loadout.name: Footnote
loadout.text: When a roll goes against you, mark a Stress to put both dice back in the cup.

loadout.name: Mark the Page
loadout.text: Keep the place you are standing. Use it again to be back there, wherever you have got to.

loadout.name: Another Round
loadout.text: A round for the house: every ally within Close range clears a Stress, and the GM gains a Shadow for it.

vault.name: Barrel Through
vault.text: Shoulder through: adversaries within Melee range take 1d8 and are shoved out to Very Close.

granted.name: Shield Trained
granted.text: You may use a shield without it counting against your burden.

granted.name: Drilled
granted.text: Long practice in armour: your Armor Score is 1 higher.

granted.name: Hold the Line
granted.text: When an ally within Melee range is attacked, you may take the blow in their place.

granted.name: Hold Fast
granted.text: Spend 3 Light to clear 2 Armor Slots.

granted.name: Bulwark Stance
granted.text: Allies directly behind you count as having cover.

granted.name: Set Feet
granted.text: You take a blow square rather than glancing: your damage thresholds are 1 higher.

granted.name: Deep Footing
granted.text: You are never knocked prone by a blow alone.

granted.name: Road Sense
granted.text: You know roughly where the nearest road runs.

granted.name: Rally the Line
granted.text: Spend a Light: every ally within Close range shakes something off — a Hit Point if they are badly hurt, a Stress if they are not.

granted.name: Pack
granted.text:
Kit
A few tricks.

And a spare.

loadout.name: Powder and Shot
loadout.text: Load: put two shots on Grapeshot. It holds no more than four.

loadout.name: Footnote
loadout.text: When a roll goes against you, mark a Stress to put both dice back in the cup.

loadout.name: Mark the Page
loadout.text: Keep the place you are standing. Use it again to be back there, wherever you have got to.

vault.name: Another Round
vault.text: A round for the house: every ally within Close range clears a Stress, and the GM gains a Shadow for it.

vault.name: Barrel Through
vault.text: Shoulder through: adversaries within Melee range take 1d8 and are shoved out to Very Close.

vault.name: Power Slash
vault.text: Put your weight behind the swing: deal 2 additional damage.

vault.name: Shield Wall
vault.text: Until your next turn, allies within Melee range gain a bonus to Evasion.

granted.name: Light Fingers
granted.text: You have advantage on rolls to take something unnoticed.

granted.name: Slip the Knot
granted.text: Once per rest, free yourself from a grapple, binding or snare without rolling.

granted.name: Douse
granted.text: Put out an unattended light within Close range as a free action.

granted.name: Softstep
granted.text: You are never quite where the eye expects: your Evasion is 1 higher.

granted.name: Green Step
granted.text: Undergrowth costs you nothing to move through.

granted.name: Someone Owes You
granted.text: In a settlement, you can usually find a contact.

granted.name: Pack
granted.text:
Kit
A few tricks.

And a spare.

Violet recalls Barrel Through and vaults Footnote.

loadout.name: Powder and Shot
loadout.text: Load: put two shots on Grapeshot. It holds no more than four.

loadout.name: Mark the Page
loadout.text: Keep the place you are standing. Use it again to be back there, wherever you have got to.

loadout.name: Barrel Through
loadout.text: Shoulder through: adversaries within Melee range take 1d8 and are shoved out to Very Close.

vault.name: Footnote
vault.text: When a roll goes against you, mark a Stress to put both dice back in the cup.

vault.name: Another Round
vault.text: A round for the house: every ally within Close range clears a Stress, and the GM gains a Shadow for it.

vault.name: Power Slash
vault.text: Put your weight behind the swing: deal 2 additional damage.

vault.name: Shield Wall
vault.text: Until your next turn, allies within Melee range gain a bonus to Evasion.

granted.name: Light Fingers
granted.text: You have advantage on rolls to take something unnoticed.

granted.name: Slip the Knot
granted.text: Once per rest, free yourself from a grapple, binding or snare without rolling.

granted.name: Douse
granted.text: Put out an unattended light within Close range as a free action.

granted.name: Softstep
granted.text: You are never quite where the eye expects: your Evasion is 1 higher.

granted.name: Green Step
granted.text: Undergrowth costs you nothing to move through.

granted.name: Someone Owes You
granted.text: In a settlement, you can usually find a contact.

granted.name: Pack
granted.text:

A few tricks.

And a spare.

loadout.name: Powder and Shot
loadout.text: Load: put two shots on Grapeshot. It holds no more than four.

loadout.name: Mark the Page
loadout.text: Keep the place you are standing. Use it again to be back there, wherever you have got to.

vault.name: Grapeshot
vault.text: Spend a shot: everything within Very Close takes 1d6 and is knocked back to Close range.

vault.name: Footnote
vault.text: When a roll goes against you, mark a Stress to put both dice back in the cup.

vault.name: Another Round
vault.text: A round for the house: every ally within Close range clears a Stress, and the GM gains a Shadow for it.

vault.name: Barrel Through
vault.text: Shoulder through: adversaries within Melee range take 1d8 and are shoved out to Very Close.

granted.name: Shield Trained
granted.text: You may use a shield without it counting against your burden.

granted.name: Drilled
granted.text: Long practice in armour: your Armor Score is 1 higher.

granted.name: Hold the Line
granted.text: When an ally within Melee range is attacked, you may take the blow in their place.

granted.name: Hold Fast
granted.text: Spend 3 Light to clear 2 Armor Slots.

granted.name: Bulwark Stance
granted.text: Allies directly behind you count as having cover.

granted.name: Set Feet
granted.text: You take a blow square rather than glancing: your damage thresholds are 1 higher.

granted.name: Deep Footing
granted.text: You are never knocked prone by a blow alone.

granted.name: Road Sense
granted.text: You know roughly where the nearest road runs.

granted.name: Rally the Line
granted.text: Spend a Light: every ally within Close range shakes something off — a Hit Point if they are badly hurt, a Stress if they are not.

granted.name: Pack
granted.text:
Kit
A few tricks.

And a spare.

granted.text: Allies directly behind you count as having cover.

log.text: Pines close over the trail, and the stream runs black between them. East, past the marsh, the vault mouth stands open in the hillside - and the cold coming out of it has never seen the sun.

log.text: Scarlet recalls Shield Wall and vaults Grapeshot, marking 1 Stress.

loadout.name: Powder and Shot
loadout.text: Load: put two shots on Grapeshot. It holds no more than four.

loadout.name: Footnote
loadout.text: When a roll goes against you, mark a Stress to put both dice back in the cup.

loadout.name: Mark the Page
loadout.text: Keep the place you are standing. Use it again to be back there, wherever you have got to.

loadout.name: Another Round
loadout.text: A round for the house: every ally within Close range clears a Stress, and the GM gains a Shadow for it.

loadout.name: Barrel Through
loadout.text: Shoulder through: adversaries within Melee range take 1d8 and are shoved out to Very Close.

vault.name: Grapeshot
vault.text: Spend a shot: everything within Very Close takes 1d6 and is knocked back to Close range.

vault.name: Power Slash
vault.text: Put your weight behind the swing: deal 2 additional damage.

granted.name: Shield Trained
granted.text: You may use a shield without it counting against your burden.

granted.name: Drilled
granted.text: Long practice in armour: your Armor Score is 1 higher.

granted.name: Hold the Line
granted.text: When an ally within Melee range is attacked, you may take the blow in their place.

granted.name: Hold Fast
granted.text: Spend 3 Light to clear 2 Armor Slots.

granted.name: Bulwark Stance
granted.text: Allies directly behind you count as having cover.

granted.name: Set Feet
granted.text: You take a blow square rather than glancing: your damage thresholds are 1 higher.

granted.name: Deep Footing
granted.text: You are never knocked prone by a blow alone.

granted.name: Road Sense
granted.text: You know roughly where the nearest road runs.

granted.name: Rally the Line
granted.text: Spend a Light: every ally within Close range shakes something off — a Hit Point if they are badly hurt, a Stress if they are not.
